howToOffer: Advise the consultant when making a reservation - purchased at time of booking.
howItWorks: Call rescue.co's 24/7 hotline to reach dispatch
Physicians/nurses provide teleguidance over the phone
If medical evacuation is required, rescue.co coordinates an aircraft (helicopter if remote/needed, otherwise airplane)
If the emergency occurs at night outside flying times, rescue.co sends a ground ambulance or nearest medical professional
For any other emergency, rescue.co coordinates an appropriate evacuation including towing or security services
